service.name: source-ledger
service.description: A scoped append-only source ledger with bounded recall, rebuildable compaction, and federated corpus search

sqlite_maintenance.rationale: Fresh files enable incremental auto-vacuum before creating schema. The owner reclaims free pages on incremental files. Legacy files keep reusing pages pending a stopped owner conversion after cursor migration and verification.

budget.rationale: Measured 551 MiB on 2026-11-26. The review ceiling covers the append-only ledger and its derived indexes as the corpus grows.

data.rationale: Authoritative append-only journal, its policies and provenance, and derived ledger indexes.

budget.rationale: Measured 33 KiB on 2026-11-26. The review ceiling catches a WAL pinned by readers.

data-wal.rationale: The owner checkpoints committed ledger writes from the WAL. Preserve it with the database.

budget.rationale: Measured 32 KiB on 2026-11-26. The review ceiling catches abnormal shared-memory growth.

data-shm.rationale: SQLite's live ledger coordination file. Preserve it with the database.

sqlite_maintenance.rationale: File changes and removals free index pages for the owner's periodic maintenance. A lifecycle-fenced owner command can convert existing caches to incremental auto-vacuum.

file_index.rationale: FTS chunks and chunk vectors derived from the research home. The owner can rebuild the index from the corpus.

budget.rationale: Measured 776 MiB on 2026-11-26. The review ceiling flags an index that stopped tracking the research home's ignore policy.
Measured 6.7 MiB on 2026-11-26. The review ceiling catches a WAL pinned by readers.

file-index-wal.rationale: Live cache WAL. The owner checkpoints it through SQLite.

budget.rationale: Measured 32 KiB on 2026-11-26. The review ceiling catches abnormal shared-memory growth.

file-index-shm.rationale: SQLite's live cache coordination file. Preserve it with the database.

budget.rationale: Measured 775 KiB on 2026-11-26. Lifecycle publishes one current deployment record.

deployment-report.rationale: Lifecycle deployment evidence published beneath the scenario data root.

retention_receipts.rationale: Retention enforcement receipts the storage owner writes for this scenario: small operational state.

budget.rationale: Receipts are bounded by size and age.

storage.rationale: Source Ledger owns the durable journal and derived engine state; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

ai-gateway.description: Provides governed classification, embedding, and summary inference for source-ledger enrichment and compaction.
ai-gateway.degraded_behavior: The append-only ledger remains durable, while enrichment and compaction pause until ai-gateway is available.

prompt-manager.description: Verifies the current investigator heartbeat owner when publishing a defect account.
prompt-manager.degraded_behavior: Capture and recall continue while account publications wait in the investigator's durable queue.

search-hub.description: Optional federated search registration for source-ledger corpus discovery.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: Source-ledger recall remains available; only external search registration is unavailable.
